title: Invertibility is equivalent to the existence of an inverse module, and identifies it as the module of homomorphisms into the structure sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises invertible modules as those admitting an inverse module, and in that case identifies the inverse with the sheaf of homomorphisms into the structure sheaf and records that the module is locally a direct summand of a finite free module (author lemma at source lines 4283-4296, label lemma-invertible). The proof (source lines 4298-4357) turns the equivalence into a statement about the tensor product functor, extracts a local splitting from the trivialising isomorphism through an automorphism factoring over a finite free module, and finally verifies the evaluation map on stalks, where the algebraic statement applies (proof lines 4306-4356). The local splitting and the stalk computation are the content. H3.
